Kyle Sterbinsky, a former Wake Forest University teammate, is the current caddie for PGA Tour golfer Cameron Young. He joined Young's team during the 2025 season after working on mini-tours, helping fuel a career turnaround that included a 2025 Wyndham Championship win and success at The Players Championship. Relationship: Sterbinsky and Young were teammates on the Wake Forest men's golf team. Impact: Sterbinsky is recognized for his exceptional green-reading abilities, which Young stated helped improve his performance significantly. History: The partnership began as a temporary arrangement at the 2025 Truist Championship after Young needed a change due to poor performance. Success: Following the partnership, Young won his first PGA Tour title at the 2025 Wyndham Championship and became a top performer in 2026. Previous Caddie: Before Sterbinsky, Paul Tesori caddied for Young in 2023 for a short period.
